ns2:course.label: College Composition I
ns2:course.description: (RHET 103) Instruction in structuring argumentative essays: concentrates on creating problem statements, making points, and providing evidence in academic essays. This is the first term of a two-term sequence (RHET 103 - RHET 104) that satisfies the campus Composition I general education requirement. Credit is not given for both RHET 103 and RHET 101. Prerequisite: Placement in RHET 103.
